svg.title: TOPAK I2 — RunSeats.tla: in Run, only a thinker seat actuates and an observer seat consults and reports, and no variant name is shared by Build and Run. Three invariants, each with the mutations that break it: checked by TLC, proved by TLAPS and in Lean
svg.desc: The module ADR-0043 §8 asks for, drawn from its own text and from every results file about it, all read at build time: the four seats and what the grant issues each, the three properties and the section each states (ADR-0043 §2, ADR-0040 §2), the mutation matrix, the provisional column's row, the witnesses, every theorem and lemma, the certified run and the Lean re-encoding. What is checked or proved here is checked or proved of the module, at its constants or by its proofs, and not of the reference. The module is frozen, cited by digest (ADR-0043 B25, ADR-0046, ADR-0053). It has no principals: the one-seat rule is Seats.tla's, and is not restated here (its header).

text.tspan: Proved in Lean, of the re-encoding

svg.text: Checked, proved and certified mean what ADR-0046 §1 says: TLC checks the mutations and witnesses at the module's constants; TLAPS proves each invariant under the hypothesis its statement names; the certified run accounts for every obligation by a route an independent checker accepted, or names LS4. Nothing here is said of the running reference. The module's header still calls ADR-0043 Proposed: it was written on 2026.09.29, before Batch 20 ratified the record.

Key. ① to ④ are Grant's conjuncts and the alphabet it writes; ⑤ is the lease; ⑥ an act from the live alphabet, recorded with the seat's kind and domain; ⑦ ends a lease and nothing else. Dotted blue lines show what each property reads; red marks where each mutation acts. Each seat's alphabet is computed from the module's KindBound and DomainActs. The picture is the diagram's own drawing of the definitions below.

svg.text: Constants: "constants: 4 seats (a thinker and an observer in each domain), 6 actions (3 Build, 3 Run)" (the file's header). M_OBSEMIT is run on Safe only, and on one witness (below); the other cells are not run.

g.text: Under the provisional column an observer seat never consults: Consult is what ADR-0043 §2 gives an observer, and the provisional column could not. The header: "which shows what the provisional column could not do".

text.tspan: property must be violated unmutated, so what the three properties forbid is not forbidden vacuously

g.text: A seat actuates: OnlyThinkersActuate ranges over a reachable Actuate.
An observer seat reports: what ObserversConsultAndReport allows is reached.
An observer seat consults: Consult, new for an observer in ADR-0043 §2, is reached. Under M_OBSEMIT it is not (above).
